answer: Fabricated agents form a hollow island of accounts with no stake-weighted history, and their votes produce a weak echo that peers detect and slash. Agents earn trust only by staking locked tokens plus a unique proof-of-personhood attestation, so spinning up many identities requires real capital and verified humans per node. Each fake identity costs a bonded stake forfeited on detection, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0131's threat model.
